evals.name: delegate-to-glm
evals.prompt: このリポジトリの失敗してるテストを GLM-5.2 に直させて、何をどう直したか結果を見せて。
evals.expected_output: Defaults to isolated mode: stages a worktree or cp -Rc clone, writes the task to a prompt file, runs scripts/acp_run.py --agent opencode --model opencode-go/glm-5.2 against that cwd, then reviews result.json + git diff before promoting — does not silently edit the live repo.

evals.name: compare-two-models
evals.prompt: この関数のリファクタを Qwen3.7 Max と DeepSeek V4 Pro の両方にやらせて、出力の違いを比較したい。
evals.expected_output: Always isolated: two separate sandboxed acp_run.py runs with --model opencode-go/qwen3.7-max and opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro in separate clones; sequential not parallel; then a comparison of the two outputs with model_verified for each.

evals.name: second-opinion-review
evals.prompt: opencode 経由で別ベンダーのモデルに、いま書いたこの変更のレビューを頼みたい。
evals.expected_output: Resolves opencode (local or npx), runs it via ACP (isolated by default) to review the change, returns the external model's feedback. Uses the bundled client; does not hand-roll an ACP handshake.

evals.name: inplace-when-asked
evals.prompt: worktree は使わず、このブランチの作業ツリーをそのまま OpenCode に渡して失敗テストを直させて。
evals.expected_output: Chooses inplace mode: --cwd is the live working tree (no worktree/cp sandbox), still runs acp_run.py with a task prompt that forbids commits unless asked, then reviews git diff in that same tree.
